summary: Antiphon nightly tests (CARD-0487). Desktop tag. 00:30 Europe/London. No suite or ref override.
description: SSH-bridge wrapper that runs scripts/nightly-run.ps1 against C:\Antiphon\nightly\checkout. Do not add a Windows Scheduled Task. The job exits with the SSH exit code; the wrapper's final stdout line is its compact JSON completion record (nativeRunId, sha, ref, trigger, profile, candidateId, creditKind, localDueDate, policyHash, coverageComplete, testsPassed, reportDelivered, exitCode, summaryPath), which Windmill stores as the job result (CARD-0545 D-10). A failed SSH hop prints no record and fails the job. CARD-0599 D-7: the wrapper derives trigger from the runner's own schedule context (WM_SCHEDULE_PATH matching this job's schedule path) and otherwise passes manual. An API caller's trigger string cannot manufacture scheduled credit; a missing schedule context refuses scheduled credit rather than defaulting to it.
content:
#!/bin/bash
set -uo pipefail
# CARD-0599 D-7: scheduled credit comes from the runner's own schedule context.
TRIGGER=manual
if [ "${WM_SCHEDULE_PATH:-}" = "u/lndcobra/antiphon_nightly_tests" ]; then TRIGGER=scheduled; fi
ssh -i /tmp/windmill/worker_to_windows -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o BatchMode=yes lndco@host.docker.internal "powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\src\Antiphon\scripts\nightly-run.ps1 -Trigger $TRIGGER -Profile nightly"
exit $?
